\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Convexity radius is continuous] 1. ch6:6-6

Suppose $(M, g)$ is a Riemannian manifold. For each $x \in M$, define the convexity radius of $M$ at $x$, denoted $\operatorname {conv}(x)$, to be the supremum of all $\varepsilon > 0$ such that there is a geodesically convex geodesic ball of radius $\varepsilon $ centered at $x$. Show that $\operatorname {conv}(x)$ is a continuous function of $x$. \end{exercise}
